title: Flight durations across time zones and valid connections
requirements: duration_minutes(flight) returns flight minutes from local times plus their UTC offsets (offsets may carry minutes, e.g. '+05:30'), correct across midnight
connections(flights, min_layover=45) returns sorted (a_id, b_id) pairs where a lands at b's origin and b departs between min_layover minutes and 6 hours (inclusive) after a lands
tests/data/flights.json loads through flights.loader with its digest check left on
(after the user switch) red_eyes(flights) returns sorted ids of flights departing 22:00-04:59 local time
user_messages: flights.duration_minutes(flight): dep/arr are local times with their own UTC offsets (dep_off/arr_off, and some offsets have minutes like +05:30). has to work across midnight
connections(flights, min_layover=45) → sorted (a_id, b_id) where a lands where b leaves from, and b leaves at least min_layover minutes after a lands but no more than 6 hours after
tests load tests/data/flights.json through flights/loader.py, keep the digest check on
also red_eyes(flights) → sorted ids of flights that leave between 22:00 and 04:59 local time
